title: DaVinci ARTIQ Replacement Kit
description:
Use your ARTIQ alot? Keep a set of these parts on hand in case of wear and tear or loss.

What’s in the box:
2 Magnetic Collars
Top AirPath Seal
Lower Air Path Seal
Lower Silicone Seal
